spans.s:
1. आर, अस्, अम्, m. n. (? fr. rt. ऋ), an angle, a
corner; N. of a tree; N. of a lake; brass; oxide of
iron; (अस्), m. the planet Mars, Ἄρης the planet
Saturn; (आ), f. a shoemaker's awl or knife, a bore,
a probe, a spoke.
—आर-कूट, अस्, अम्, m. n. brass.
—आराग्र (˚रा-अग्˚), अम्, n. the point of an awl;
the iron thong at the end (of a whip); the edge of
a semicircular arrow-head; (अस्, आ, अम्), sharpened,
sharp at the top and broad at the bottom like an awl.
—आरावली (˚रा-आव्˚), f., N. of a chain of mountains,
a spur of the Vindhya.

आर 2. आर (contained in आरात्, आरे, q. v.),
distance; proximity (?).

आर 3. आर, probably a wrong reading for
अर, a spoke, q. v.

आरा आरा, f. a probe, an awl. See under
2. आर्.

—अर-नेमि, इस्, m., N. of Brahma-datta, king of
Kośala.
—अरान्तरेषु (˚र-अन्˚), loc. pl. in the in-
tervals of the spokes.

अरक्षस् अ-रक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. harm-
less, honest; not disturbed &c. by evil spirits.

अरक्षित अ-रक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, unprotected,
undefended; not preserved, not kept.
अरगराट अरगराट, अस्, m., Ved. a valley (?).

अरङ्कृ अरङ्-कृ, cl. 8. P., Ved. -करोति, -कर्-
तुम्, to prepare, make ready; serve. See अरम्, col. 3.

अरङ्-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. acting satisfactorily; pre-
paring, serving as a worshipper.

अरङ्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prepared, ready; gra-
tified.
अरङ्कृति, इस्, f., Ved. service, gratification.

अरङ्गम् अरङ्-गम्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -गच्छति,
-गन्तुम्, to be present, come near (in order to help),
become visible, appear. See अरम्, col. 3.

अरङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. coming near or into
the presence, appearing (in order to help), becoming
visible.

अरङ्गर अरङ्-गर, अस्, m., Ved. praising rea-
dily (?); factitious or made up poison. See अरम्.

आरङ्गर आरङ्गर, अस्, m., Ved. epithet of
a bee.

अरङ्गिन् अ-रङ्-गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, passionless.
—अरङ्गि-सत्त्व, अस्, m. a passionless being, a class
of gods with Buddhists.

अरङ्घुष अरङ्-घुष, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. prais-
ing readily, sounding aloud. See अरम्, col. 3.

अरजस् अ-रजस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or अ-रज or
अ-रजस्क, अस्, आ, अम्, dustless; free from passion
or desire; clean, pure; not having the monthly
courses; (आस्), f. a young girl.

अरजाय, nom. A. अरजायते, -यितुम्, to become
dustless; to lose the monthly courses.

अरज्जु अ-रज्जु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not consist-
ing of cords; not furnished with cords.

अरटु अरटु or अरडु, उस्, m., N. of the tree
Calosanthes Indica Bl.

अरट्व, अस्, आ, अम्, made of the wood of the
above tree; (अस्), m., N. of a man.

अरण 1. अरण, अस्, ई, अम् (rt. ऋ), Ved. de-
parted, gone away; strange, foreign; distant; (अम्),
n. moving, entering; being inserted; a refuge.

अरण 2. अ-रण, अस्, आ, अम्, not fighting,
without fighting.

आरण आरण, अम्, n. (probably related to
1. अरण), Ved. depth, abyss, precipice.

1. अरणि, इस्, ई, m. f. the wood of the Ficus Re-
ligiosa used for kindling fire by attrition; the lower
one (अधरारणि) of the two Araṇis; (ई), du. the
two pieces of wood used in kindling the sacred fire;
(इस्), m., N. of several plants, especially Premna
Integrifolia; the sun; fire; a flint?; (इस्), f. a
way, a path.
—अरणि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, related to
the two Araṇis; to be produced by the Araṇis.
—अरणी-केतु, उस्, m. the Premna Integrifolia.
अरणि 2. अ-रणि, इस्, f., Ved. stinginess.
आरणि आरणि, इस्, m. an eddy.

अरण्य अरण्य, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. rt. ऋ),
land neither cultivated nor grazed; a wilderness,
desert, forest; N. of a plant; N. of a Sādhya.
—अरण्य-कणा, f. wild cumin seed.
—अरण्य-
कदली, f. the wood or wild plantain.
—अरण्य-
काण्ड (?), अम्, n. title of the third book of the
Rāmāyaṇa.
—अरण्य-कार्पासी, f. the wild cotton.
—अरण्य-कुलत्थिका, f., N. of the plant Glycine
Labialis Lin.
—अरण्य-कुसुम्भ, अस्, m., N. of
the plant Carthamus Tinctorius.
—अरण्य-गज,
अस्, m. a wild elephant.
—अरण्य-गत, अस्, आ,
अम्, gone into a forest.
—अरण्य-गान (?), अम्,
n. one of the four Gānas or hymn-books of the
Sāma-veda.
—अरण्य-घोली, f., N. of a plant.
—अ-
रण्य-चटक, अस्, m. a wild pigeon.
—अरण्य-
चर, अस्, ई, अम्, living in forests, wild.
—अरण्य-ज,
अस्, आ, अम्, produced or born in a forest.
—अरण्य-
जार्द्रका (˚ज-आर्द्˚), f. wild ginger.
—अरण्य-जीर,
अस्, m. wild cumin.
—अरण्य-जीव, अस्, आ, अम्, living
in a forest.
—अरण्य-दमन, अस्, m. a wild plant,
called दोन.
—अरण्य-द्वादशी, f. or अरण्यद्वा-
दशी-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a ceremony performed on
the twelfth day of the month Mārgaśīrṣa.
—अरण्य-
[]
धर्म, अस्, m. forest usage, wild or savage state.
—अरण्य-धान्य, अम्, n. wild rice.
—अरण्य-
नृपति, इस्, m. king of the forest.
—अरण्य-
भव, अस्, आ, अम्, growing in a forest, wild.
—अ-
रण्य-मक्षिका, f. the gad-fly.
—अरण्य-मार्-
जार, अस्, m. wild cat.
—अरण्य-मुद्ग, अस्, m.
a kind of bean.
—अरण्य-यान, अम्, n. going
into a forest.
—अरण्य-रक्षक, अस्, m. forest-
keeper, superintendent of a forest district.
—अरण्य-
राज्, ट्, m. king of the forest; epithet of a lion or tiger.
—अरण्य-राज्य, अम्, n. the sovereignty of the
forest.
—अरण्य-रुदित, अम्, n. weeping in a forest,
i. e. weeping in vain, with no one to hear.
—अरण्य-
वत्, ind. like a wilderness.
—अरण्य-वायस, अस्,
m. a raven.
—अरण्य-वास, अस्, m. a hermitage.
—अरण्य-वासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, living in a forest, wild;
(ई), m. forest-dweller, a hermit, anchorite; (नी),
f., N. of a plant.
—अरण्य-वास्तुक or अरण्य-वा-
स्तूक, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
—अरण्य-शालि, इस्, m.
wild rice.
—अरण्य-शूकर, अस्, m. a wild hog.
—अरण्य-शूरण, अस्, m., N. of a plant.
—अ-
रण्य-श्वन्, आ, m. a wolf.
—अरण्य-षष्ठी, f.,
N. of a festival celebrated by females in the month
Jyaiṣṭha.
—अरण्य-सभा, f. a forest court.
—अ-
रण्याध्यक्ष (˚य-अध्˚), अस्, m. forest-keeper or
ranger, a head-man or superintendent of a forest dis-
trict.
—अरण्यायन (˚य-अय्˚), अम्, n. going into
the forest, becoming a hermit.
—अरण्ये-तिलक, अस्,
m. wild sesamum growing in a forest and containing
no oil; hence, anything which disappoints expectation.
—अरण्ये-ऽनूच्य (˚ये-अन्˚), अस्, m., Ved. a kind of
oblation.
—अरण्यौकस् (˚य-ओक्˚), आस्, m. living in
a forest, a Brāhman who has left his family and be-
come an anchorite.

आरण्य आरण्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. अरण्य),
forest, relating to a forest, forest-born, wild; (आस्), m.
pl. wild animals.
—आरण्य-गान, अम्, n. one of the
four Gānas or psalm-books of the Sāma-veda.
—आ-
रण्य-पर्वन्, अ, n., N. of the third book of the
Mahā-bhārata, more usually called वन-पर्वन्.
—आरण्य-पशु, उस्, m. a wild or forest animal (as a
buffalo, monkey, &c.).
—आरण्य-मुद्गा, f. a kind
of bean, Phaseolus Trilobus Ait.
—आरण्य-राशि, इस्,
m. (in the zodiac) the sign Leo; Aries and Taurus;
the former half of Capricorn.
अरण्यक, अम्, n. a forest, a desert; N. of a plant.

आरण्यक, अस्, आ, अम्, forest, wild, forest-born,
produced in a forest, relating to a forest; the आर-
ण्यकम् पर्व of the Mahā-bhārata is either the
whole third book or only the first section of it; (अस्),
m. a forester, an inhabitant of the woods; (अम्), n.
an आरण्यक, i. e. one of a class of religious and phi-
losophical writings (closely connected with the Brāh-
maṇas) which are either composed in forests or must
be studied there; the Upaniṣads are considered to
be attached to them.
—आरण्यक-काण्ड, अम्, n.
title of the third book of the Rāmāyaṇa and of the
fourteenth book of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.

अरण्यानि, इस्, or अरण्यानी, f. a wilderness, desert,
large forest; the goddess of the wilderness and desert,
and mother of wild animals.

अरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, containing a forest, near to
one.

अरत अ-रत, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रम्), dull,
languid, apathetic; disgusted, discontented; (अम्), n.
non-copulation.
—अ-रत-त्रप, अस्, आ, अम्, not
ashamed of copulation; (अस्), m. a dog.
आ-रत, अस्, आ, अम्, quiet, gentle.
आ-रत; add — (अम्), n. a kind of coitus.

1. अ-रति, इस्, f. dissatisfaction, discontent; absence
of pleasure, pain; dulness, languor; anxiety, distress,
regret; a bilious disease; (इस्, इस्, इ), discontented, un-
happy; dull, languid, restless.
—अरति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, dull, spiritless.

अरति 2. अरति, इस्, m. (fr. rt. ऋ, cf. अर,
अरम्), Ved. going, approaching; moving quickly;
moving flame; occupying; attacking; a servant, assist-
ant, manager, administrator; a master; an intelligent
being of all-piercing intellect; anger, passion; anxiety.

अराति अ-राति, इस्, f. (rt. रा), Ved. the non-
offering (of sacrifice); stinginess, hardness, disfavour,
severity; malignity, malevolence; failure; adversity;
malignity personified; particular evil spirits, who frus-
trate the good intentions and disturb the happiness of
man; (इस्), m. an enemy; the number ‘six.’
—अराति-
दूषण, अस्, ई, अम्, or अराति-दूषि, इस्, इस्, इ, or
अराति-ह, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. destroying enemies or ad-
versity.
—अराति-भङ्ग, अस्, m. defeat of a foe.

आ-रति, इस्, f. stopping, ceasing; waving lights be-
fore an image.
आराति आराति, इस्, m. an enemy. See अ-राति.

अरत्नि अरत्नि, इस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. ऋ),
the elbow, a corner; a cubit of the middle length,
from the elbow to tip of the little finger, a fist.
—अरत्नि-मान्त्र, अस्, ई, अम्, one ell in length.
अरत्निक, अस्, m. the elbow.
अरथ अ-रथ, अस्, आ, अम्, having no carriage.

अ-रथिन्, ई, m. a warrior who does not fight in a
car, or owns, no car.
अ-रथी, ईस्, m., Ved. not a charioteer.

अरध्र अ-रध्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not lazy;
not to be subdued; unprosperous.
अरन्तुक अरन्तुक, अस्, m., N. of a Tīrtha.

अरप अ-रप, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. unhurt; sin-
less, pure.

अ-रपस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. unhurt, safe; not hurt-
ing, beneficial, charitable; sinless, pure.

अरपचन अरपचन, अस्, m. a mystical col-
lective N. of the five Buddhas, each being represented
by a letter.

अरम् अरम्, ind. (fr. rt. ऋ, see अर), Ved.
swiftly, at hand, near, present; readily, fitly, suitably,
so as to answer a purpose; enough, sufficient [cf. अलम्
[]
and Gr. ἄρα].
—अरङ्-कृ and अरङ्-गम्, see
p. 80, col. 2.
—अरमणस्, आस्, आस्, अस् (for अरम्-
म्˚), Ved. ready to serve, obedient, devoted to the
worship of God; (according to native interpreta-
tion) having hostile intentions.
—अरमति, इस्, f. (for
अरम्-म्˚), Ved. readiness to serve, obedience, devo-
tion; a goddess, described in the Vedas as protecting
the worshippers of the gods and pious works in
general; (according to others) not resting, active,
going everywhere; splendor.
—अरम्-इष्, ट्, ट्, ट्,
Ved. hastening near (?).

आरम् आ-रम्, cl. 1. P. -रमति, -रन्तुम्, to
delight in; to rest; to leave off.

अरमण अ-रमण, अस्, ई, अम् (rt. रम्), not
gratifying, not pleasing.

आ-रमण, अम्, n. taking delight; cessation, pause;
resting-place.

अ-रमणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, unpleasant, disagreeable.
—अरमणीय-ता, f. disagreeableness.

अ-रममाण, अस्, आ, अम्, not gratifying; Ved.
unremitting, unceasing.
अ-रमयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, not causing gratification.
अरमुडि अरमुडि, इस्, m. a king of Nepāl.
अररि, इस्, इ, m. n. a door; a door-leaf.

अररका अररका, f., N. of the ancestress
of a celebrated Hindū family.
अररक्य, अस्, m. a descendant of Ararakā.

अररिन्द अररिन्द, अम्, n., Ved. water; a
vessel used in preparing the Soma juice (?).

अररिवस् अ-ररिवस्, वान्, उषी, m. f. (rt. रा),
Ved. not offering; envious, hard, cruel, unfriendly; an
epithet of evil spirits, who strive to disturb the happi-
ness of man; an enemy.

1. अ-ररु, उस्, m. = the preceding; N. of an Asura;
(उस्), m. f. (?) a weapon.
अररु 2. अररु, उस्, उस्, उ (rt. ऋ), Ved. moving.

अररे अररे, ind. a vocative particle, ex-
pressing haste.

अरर्य अरर्य, nom. P. अरर्यति, -यितुम्, to
work with an awl; to try, put to the proof (?).

अरलु अरलु, उस्, or अरलुक, अस्, m. a plant,
Bignonia Indica.
अरव अ-रव, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रु), noiseless.
आरव, आराव See under 1. आ-रु.

आ-रव, अस्, m. cry, crying, howling, crash, sound;
N. of a people.

आ-राव, अस्, m. cry, crying; humming (of bees
&c.); sound.

अरविन्द अरविन्द, अम्, n. (fr. अ, ‘like,’ and
रविन्द, q. v., for रवि-द?), a lotus, Nelumbium
Speciosum or Nymphæa Nelumbo; (अस्), m. the In-
dian crane; copper.
—अरविन्द-दल-प्रभ, अम्,
n. copper.
—अरविन्द-नाभि, इस्, m. Viṣṇu, from
whose navel sprung the lotus that bore Brahmā at
the creation.
—अरविन्द-सद्, त्, m., N. of Brahmā,
‘sitting on a lotus.’
अरविन्दिनी, f. an assemblage of lotus flowers.

अरश्मन् अ-रश्मन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having no
ropes or reins.

अरस अ-रस, अस्, आ, अम्, sapless, tasteless;
weak, effectless, having no strength; dull, flat; insi-
pid; (अस्), m. no juice, absence of juice.
—अरसाश
(˚स-आश), अस्, m. the eating of sapless food; mace-
ration of the body.
—अरसाशिन् (˚स-आश्˚), ई, इनी, इ,
eating sapless food; macerating the body.

अ-रसिक, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of taste, unfeeling,
dull; insipid, flavourless.
अरहस् अ-रहस्, अस्, n. absence of secrecy.
अरहाय, nom. A. -यते, -यितुम्, to become public.

अरहित अ-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, not deprived
of, possessed of, having.

अराग अ-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, or अ-रागिन्, ई, इणी,
इ, unimpassioned, cool.

आराग आ-राग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. रञ्ज् with आ),
one of the seven suns at the end of a period of the
world.

अराजक अ-राजक, अस्, आ, अम्, having no
king or governor, anarchical.
अ-राजन्, आ, m., Ved. not a king.

अ-राजभोगीन, अस्, आ, अम्, not fit for the enjoy-
ment or use of a king.

अ-राजस्थापित, अस्, आ, अम्, not allowed or licensed
by government.

अ-राजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. having no splendor; un-
checked, uncontrolled.

अराटकी अराटकी, f., Ved., N. or epithet of
the plant Ajaśṛṅgī.

अरातिय or अरातीय, nom. P., Ved. -यति, -यि-
तुम्, to desire not to offer; to act like an enemy.
—अरातीयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. envious, unfriendly,
not offering; behaving like an enemy, striving to
cause adversity.
आरातीय, अस्, आ, अम्, remote; near, proximate.
अरातीयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. not in the habit of offering.

अराती-वन्, आ, m., Ved. not offering, not giving;
unfriendly, malicious.

अराद्धि अ-राद्धि, इस्, f., Ved. transgression,
sin, envy.

अराधस् अ-राधस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. too poor
to perform sacrifices, not making oblations, unkind,
hard, stringy, selfish.

अराय अ-राय, अस्, m., Ved. too poor to make
oblations, obstructing a sacrifice; niggard, stingy;
(अस्, ई,) m. f. any evil spirit.
—अराय-क्षयण, अस्,
ई, अम्, Ved. overpowering malignant spirits; (अम्), n.
destruction of malignant spirits.
—अराय-चातन, अस्,
ई, अम्, Ved. destroying evil spirits; (अम्), n. destruc-
tion of evil spirits.

अराल अराल, अस्, आ, अम् (connected with अर,
fr. rt. ऋ; Intens. for अरार?), crooked, curved;
spreading like the spoke of a wheel; (अस्), m. a
bent or crooked arm; the resin of the plant Shorea
Robusta; an elephant in rut; (आ), f. a disloyal or un-
chaste woman; a modest woman.
—अराल-पक्ष्म-
नयन, अस्, आ, अम्, whose eyelashes are curved.

अरावन् अ-रावन्, आ, व्णी, अ, Ved. not offering,
envious, inimical, odious; an epithet of evil spirits.

अराष्ट्र अ-राष्ट्र, अम्, n., Ved. loss of royal
power or of a kingdom.
आरकात्, ind., Ved. (with abl.) far from.
आरक्त आ-रक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (see 3. आ), reddish.

आरक्ष आ-रक्ष, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रक्ष्), pre-
served, defended, proper or worthy to be preserved;
(अस्), m. protection, guard, preservation; the junction
of the frontal sinuses of an elephant; the part of the
forehead below this junction.

आ-रक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what guards or
protects; (अस्), m. a watchman; see the next.

आ-रक्षिक, अस्, m. a watchman, a patrol; a vil-
lage or police magistrate.
आ-रक्ष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be preserved or guarded.

आरग्बध आरग्-बध, अस्, m. the tree Ca-
thartocarpus (Cassia) Fistula; (अम्), n. its fruit.

आरचित आ-रचित, अस्, आ, अम् (rt. रच्), ar-
ranged, prepared.

आरट आरट, अम्, n. flesh. (This word is
also one of the Gaṇa गौरादि Pāṇini

आरट्ट आरट्ट, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people
and country in Pañca-nada or the Pañjāb.
—आरट्ट-ज,
अस्, आ, अम्, born in Āraṭṭa; (अस्), m. an inhabitant
of this country; a horse from it.

आरडव आरडव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अरडु),
Pāṇini

आरणज आरणज, आस्, m. pl., N. of a class
of deities forming part of the Kalpa-bhavas.

आरणेय आरणेय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. अरणि, q. v.),
relating to the Araṇis or two pieces of wood by the
attrition of which sacred fire is kindled; (अम्), n.
or आरणेय-पर्वन्, अ, n. title of the last section of
the third book of the Mahā-bhārata.

आरद्ध आरद्ध, अस्, or आरद्वत्, आन्, m., N.
of a son of Setu.

आरनाल आरनाल or आरनालक, अम्, n. sour
gruel made from the fermentation of boiled rice.

आरभ् आ-रभ्, cl. 1. A. -रभते, -रब्धुम्,
to commence, begin, undertake; to be active or ener-
getic; to rely, obtain.
आ-रब्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, begun, commenced.
आ-रब्धि, इस्, f. beginning, commencement.

आ-रभट, अस्, m. an enterprising, courageous
man; (अस्, ई), m. f. boldness, confidence; (ई), f. a
branch of the dramatic art, the machinery of the
drama, the representation of supernatural and horrible
events on the stage.

आ-रभमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, beginning, commencing
resolutely with a determination to finish.
आ-रभ्य, ind. having begun, beginning from.
आ-रभ्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being commenced.

आ-रम्भ, अस्, m. undertaking, beginning; a
thing begun; commencement; haste, speed; effort,
exertion; pride; killing, slaughter; an introduction,
a prologue, &c.
—आरम्भ-ता, f. beginning.
आ-रम्भक, अस्, ई, अम्, undertaking, beginning.

आ-रम्भण, अम्, n. taking hold of, seizing,
using; the place of seizing, a handle.
—आरम्भण-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, seizable.

आ-रम्भणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, that with which one
must begin, forming the commencement.

आ-रम्भिन्, ई, इणी, इ, enterprising, one who makes
many new projects.

आ-राम, अस्, m. delight, pleasure; place of pleasure,
a garden, a grove; [with this word cf. ἠμέρα and
ἔρημος]
—आराम-शीतला, f., N. of a fragrant plant.
आरामिक, अस्, m. a gardener.

आरम्बण आ-रम्बण, अम्, n. (= आ-लम्बन),
support.

आरस् आ-रस्, cl. 1. P. -रसति, -सितुम्, to
bewail, to lament.

आरस्य आरस्य, अम्, n. (fr. अ-रस), insi-
pidity, want of flavour or spirit.

आराज्ञी आ-राज्ञी, f. (fr. राजन् with 3. अ), N.
of a region.

आराड आराड, अस्, m. with the epithet
कालाप, N. of a teacher of Śākya-muni.

आराढि आराढि, इस्, m. a patronymic of a
teacher named Saugata in the Aitareya-Brāhmaṇa.

आरात् आरात्, ind. (see 2. आर), from a dis-
tant place; distant; to a distant place; far from (with
abl.); near; directly, immediately.
आरात्तात्, ind., Ved. from a distant place.

आरात्रिक आ-रात्रिक, अम्, n. the light or the
vessel containing it which is waved at night before
an idol; N. of this ceremony; N. of another cere-
mony.

आराध् आ-राध्, cl. 5. P. -राध्नोति, -राद्धुम्,
or Caus. P. -राधयति, -यितुम्, to conciliate, pro-
pitiate; strive to obtain the favour of; to honour,
worship; to deserve, merit: Pass. -राध्यते, to be
effected or accomplished.

आ-राधक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what worships,
a worshipper.

आ-राधन, अम्, n. propitiating, rendering favour-
able to one's self; (अम्), n. accomplishment, under-
taking; cooking; acquirement, attainment; grati-
fying, propitiating, worshipping; (आ), f. service; (ई),
f. worship, adoration, propitiation of the deities.

आ-राधनीय or आ-राधितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be
worshipped or adored, to be conciliated or propitiated.

आ-राधयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, endeavouring to conci-
liate or propitiate.

आ-राधयिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, propitiatory; = the
preceding.

आ-राध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be made favourable, to
be worshipped.

आ-राध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being in course of
fulfilment, being accomplished; being worshipped,
receiving worship.

आरालिक आरालिक, अस्, ई, m. f. a cook,
(etymology doubtful, said to be fr. अराल, i. e. bend-
ing over dishes.)
आरावली आरावली, f. See under 2. आर्.
आ-राविन्, ई, m. epithet of Jayasena.
